title: Neighbourhood influence on health in epilepsy
title_zh: 癫痫患者健康的邻里影响
abstract: A retrospective study of epilepsy-surgery candidates shows that the socioeconomic status of the neighbourhood in which the candidate lived is linked to network-level brain alterations. The finding adds to the growing body of evidence that supports an important role for social factors in shaping health outcomes in epilepsy.
abstract_zh: 一项针对癫痫手术候选者的回顾性研究显示，候选者所居住邻里的社会经济地位与网络水平的脑部改变相关联。这一发现增加了越来越多的证据，支持社会因素在塑造癫痫患者健康结局方面发挥重要作用。
